oracles.local_publish_failure: current verified fact/working delivered; manifestNone; local profile unconfirmed; no new ordinary receipts/window claims; complete same-invocation source rows and exact capsuleSHA outside modelcapsule; old rows unchanged
oracles.governed_failure: exception before ordinary receipt pair, no returned capsule; old rows unchanged
oracles.prune_failure: confirmed real manifest remains usable; actual ordinary receipt pair may commit; actual current fact delivered
oracles.partial_effect_then_error: manifest may exist, outcome unconfirmed not absent/noop; no receipt pair; no adoption/deletion/retry
oracles.cancellation: BaseException propagates and no new receipt claims for unconfirmed publication
oracles.Harness: explicit ephemeral negotiated response, complete exact bound proof accepted; actual map equals normal same-invocation manifest values; approval/freshness compares material/hash as before
oracles.refusals: wrong/missing/duplicate/extra/invalid path/hash, boolrev,wronguuid,stale/corrupt claimed manifest,governed scope,frame mutation,oversize/missing profile rejected; zero visible only valid complete empty explicit proof
oracles.budget: modelcapsule still<=8000 chars, proof transport<=65536UTF8 bytes/32 rows; no effectful re-pack, every metadata/read-byte cost charged
oracles.trace_cleanup: each exact owned fd retired then attempted once; ordinary close failures do not mask capsule/primary; drain other ownedfds before cancellation; directory child registered before closing parent; uncertain fd not retried
oracles.legacy: old helper no marker => no new flag; default raw retrieve contract unchanged
